Name: Obadiah, Steward of Ahab
Summary: Obadiah, who was over Ahab's house, feared the LORD greatly and hid a hundred prophets in caves and fed them when Jezebel slew the LORD's prophets; he is distinct from Obadiah the prophet.
KeyStory: Obadiah hides a hundred prophets from Jezebel.
LifeLesson: Quiet courage feeds prophets in caves while the court serves Baal.
